content.text: {"notes":["The world frame is right-handed with x forward, y left, and z up; forward_position and forward_velocity are therefore world-x quantities in metres and metres per second.","A scheduled intervention begins at t=0.5516 s and runs to t=2.0 s; after onset, zero-velocity braking is applied at each axle with a maximum torque of 0.25 N·m.","The controller is evaluated before every 0.0001 s integration step, and scheduled-event intervals use the convention [start, end).","stopped_by_T is true only if absolute forward speed is below 0.02 m/s and planar speed is below 0.03 m/s continuously for 0.2 s, with the qualifying interval ending by T."]}
